body:
Package-mode composition rejects verified dependency declarations when their test-project paths are absent from the Platform checkout. Treat release-snapshot test profiles as metadata after the existing release authority checks, and recheck the exact file hash at the validation boundary.

Caller-supplied owner manifests retain full file ownership checks. Schema, canonical path and executor validation still apply to release metadata, and startup tasks still require their executable files.

Validation:

- Fresh full owning Module.Tests Debug build: zero warnings and errors.
- 37 focused cases pass with no failures or skips: 9 new boundary regressions, 17 existing declaration/provenance cases and 11 invalid active selections.
- The actual Platform snapshot layout loads EventStore, Tenants and Memories without copied dependency test files or allocated services. That local diagnostic explicitly supplies the independently verified release bindings from #153 through existing declaration options.
- Exact commit message and PR title pass pinned commitlint 21.2.4.

Platform snapshot adoption requires both this correction and #153. These results qualify declaration/layout behavior only; reference caller activation, published-tool adoption and hosted lifecycle qualification remain separate gates.
title: fix(runtime): validate released dependency test metadata
head: fix/released-dependency-test-profiles
display_title: fix(runtime): validate released dependency test metadata
